cues.en: If you are, at first, lonely, be patient.
cues.zh: 如果你一开始感到孤独，耐心点。

cues.en: If you've not been alone much or if when you were, you weren't okay with it, then just wait. You'll find it's fine to be alone once you're embracing it.
cues.zh: 如果你很少独处，或者独处时感觉不自在，那就等等。一旦你拥抱独处，你会发现它其实很好。

cues.en: We could start with the acceptable places,
cues.zh: 我们可以从那些可以接受的地方开始，

cues.en: the bathroom, the coffee shop, the library,
cues.zh: 洗手间、咖啡店、图书馆，

cues.en: where you can stall and read the paper, where you can get your caffeine fix and sit and stay there, where you can browse the stacks and smell the books. You're not supposed to talk much anyway, so it's safe there.
cues.zh: 在那里你可以磨蹭、读报纸，可以补充咖啡因，坐下来待着，可以浏览书架、闻闻书香。反正那里也不该多说话，所以很安全。

cues.en: There's also the gym. If you're shy, you can hang out with yourself in mirrors. You could put headphones in.
cues.zh: 还有健身房。如果你害羞，可以对着镜子和自己待着。你可以戴上耳机。

cues.en: And there's public transportation
cues.zh: 还有公共交通，

cues.en: because we all gotta go places.
cues.zh: 因为我们都得出门。

cues.en: And there's prayer and meditation. No one will think less if you're hanging with your breath seeking peace and salvation.
cues.zh: 还有祈祷和冥想。如果你专注于呼吸、寻求平静与救赎，没人会看低你。

cues.en: Start simple. Things you may have previously avoided based on your avoid being alone principles.
cues.zh: 从简单的事开始。那些你以前因为“避免独处”原则而回避的事。

cues.en: The lunch counter, where you will be surrounded by chow downers, employees at only half an hour and their spouses work across town and so they, like you, will be alone.
cues.zh: 午餐柜台，你会被埋头吃饭的人包围，员工只有半小时午休，而他们的配偶在城另一头工作，所以他们和你一样，都是独自一人。

cues.en: Resist the urge to hang out with your cell phone.
cues.zh: 克制住掏出手机消磨时间的冲动。

cues.en: When you are comfortable with eat lunch and run, take yourself out for dinner, a restaurant with linen and silverware.
cues.zh: 当你习惯了吃完午餐就走，就带自己去吃晚餐，找一家有亚麻桌布和银餐具的餐厅。

cues.en: You're no less intriguing a person when you're eating solo desserts and cleaning the whipped cream from the dish with your finger.
cues.zh: 当你独自吃甜点、用手指抹掉盘子里的奶油时，你依然是个有趣的人。

cues.en: In fact, some people at full tables will wish they were where you were.
cues.zh: 事实上，有些满桌的人会希望自己身处你的位置。

cues.en: Go to the movies, for it is dark and soothing,
cues.zh: 去看场电影吧，那里昏暗又抚慰人心，

cues.en: alone in your seat amidst a fleeting community.
cues.zh: 独自坐在座位上，置身于短暂的群体之中。

cues.en: And then take yourself out dancing to a club where no one knows you. Stand on the outside of the floor until the lights convince you more and more and the music shows you.
cues.zh: 然后带自己去跳舞，去一家没人认识你的俱乐部。站在舞池外，直到灯光越来越让你信服，音乐向你展示。

cues.en: Dance like no one's watching because they're probably not.
cues.zh: 像没人看着那样跳舞，因为他们大概确实没在看。

cues.en: And if they are, assume it is with best and human intentions.
cues.zh: 就算在看，也假定那是出于善意和人之常情。

cues.en: The way bodies move genuinely to beads is after all gorgeous and affecting.
cues.zh: 身体随节拍真诚舞动的样子，终究是绚丽动人的。

cues.en: Dance until you're sweating, and beads of perspiration remind you of life's best things, down your back like a brook of blessings.
cues.zh: 跳到出汗，汗珠让你想起生命中最好的东西，沿着后背流下，像一条祝福的小溪。

cues.en: Go to the woods alone and the trees and squirrels will watch for you.
cues.zh: 独自去树林里，树木和松鼠会替你守望。

cues.en: Go to an unfamiliar city, roam the streets, there are always statues to talk to, and benches made for sitting give strangers a shared existence if only for a minute. And these moments can be so uplifting and the conversations you get in by sitting alone on benches
cues.zh: 去一座陌生的城市，在街上漫游，总有雕像可以交谈，为坐下而设的长椅让陌生人共享存在，哪怕只有一分钟。这些时刻能如此振奋人心，而你独自坐在长椅上获得的对话

cues.en: might have never happened had you not been there by yourself.
cues.zh: 若非你独自在场，或许永远不会发生。

cues.en: Society is afraid of alone though, like lonely hearts are wasting away in basements. Basements.
cues.zh: 可社会害怕独处，仿佛孤独的心在地下室里虚度。地下室。

cues.en: Like people must have problems if after a while nobody is dating them.
cues.zh: 仿佛一段时间没人约会，人就一定有问题。

cues.en: But lonely is a freedom that breathes easy and weightless, and lonely is healing if you make it.
cues.zh: 但孤独是一种自由，呼吸轻松、没有重量，只要你愿意，孤独就是疗愈。

cues.en: You could stand swathed by groups and mobs or hold hands with your partner.
cues.zh: 你可以被成群结队的人包围，也可以与伴侣手牵手。

cues.en: Look both further and farther in the endless quest for company.
cues.zh: 在无尽的寻求陪伴之路上，看得更远，走得更远。

cues.en: But no one's in your head, and by the time you translate your thoughts, some essence of them may be lost or perhaps it is just kept.
cues.zh: 但没有人能进入你的头脑，当你把想法转译出来时，某些精髓可能已经丢失，或者恰好被保留了下来。

cues.en: Perhaps in the interest of loving oneself.
cues.zh: 也许是为了爱自己。

cues.en: Perhaps all those sappy slogans from preschool over to high school's groaning were tokens for holding the lonely at bay.
cues.zh: 也许从幼儿园到高中那些令人呻吟的俗气口号，正是用来抵挡孤独的令牌。

cues.en: Because if you're happy in your head, solitude is blessed and alone is okay.
cues.zh: 因为如果你在自己的头脑中感到快乐，独处就是一种福气，孤单也没关系。

cues.en: It's okay if no one believes like you, all experience is unique. No one has the same synapses,
cues.zh: 如果没有人像你一样相信，也没关系，所有经历都是独一无二的。没有人拥有和你相同的突触，

cues.en: can't think like you, for this, be relieved.
cues.zh: 无法像你一样思考，为此，你可以放心了。

cues.en: Keeps things interesting,
cues.zh: 这让事情保持有趣，

cues.en: life's magic things in reach.
cues.zh: 让生活中的神奇触手可及。

cues.en: And it doesn't mean you aren't connected, the community is not present. Just take the perspective you get from being one person in one head and feel it affectsively.
cues.zh: 这并不意味着你没有连接，社群并不在场。只需从身为一个头脑中的一个人所获得的视角出发，去真切地感受它。

cues.en: Take silence and respect it. If you have an art that needs a practice, stop neglecting it. If your family doesn't get you or a religious sect is not meant for you, don't obsess about it. You could be, in an instant, surround it if you need it.
cues.zh: 接纳沉默并尊重它。如果你有一门需要练习的技艺，别再忽视它。如果你的家人不理解你，或者某个宗教派别不适合你，不要为此纠结。如果你需要，你可以在瞬间置身其中。

cues.en: If your heart is bleeding, make the best of it. There is heat and freezing. Be a testament.
cues.zh: 如果你的心在滴血，就充分利用它。有炽热也有严寒。做一个见证者。
